almostunified:
Unify all resources. 

 Information

This is a mod for [Minecraft]-[NeoForge] and [Fabric].

Big modpacks often end up with the same resource from several mods: five copper ingots that don't stack and recipes that only accept one of them. Almost Unified picks one target item per tag, based on a mod priority list, and makes recipes, loot and recipe viewers use it. Recipe inputs accept the whole tag, so items from other mods stay usable, also in existing worlds.

It is made for modpack developers and adds no items, recipes or ore generation of its own. Immersive Engineering support comes from the separate add-on [AU: Immersive Engineering].

 Features

- recipe inputs are replaced with their tag and outputs with the target item
- target items chosen by priority overrides, then the mod priority list
- ore tags respect stone variants
- duplicate recipes created by the unification are removed

 For Minecraft 1.17-1.20.4 

 Requires Necronomicon API and Fabric API. 

 

Lightweight, serverside mod that allows to define custom formulas to calculate damage reduction from armor and the protection enchantment.

 

 The reason behind this?

 Vista Aeronautics Fix 
Vista Aeronautics Fix is a lightweight client-side addon designed to resolve rendering issues with Vista TVs when placed on moving contraptions from Create Aeronautics.

 The Problem 
The original Vista mod uses an advanced optimization system (LOD and Plane Culling). When a TV is part of an active Aeronautics assembly (like an airship or a train), these systems often incorrectly determine that the screen is off-screen or too far away. This causes the display to flicker, disappear, or stop updating entirely while in motion.

 Without the Fix 
 

 With the Fix

lucky-block-island:
[LBI]幸运方块空岛 (Lucky Block Island)

 The English description is below. 

 简介

本数据包会在 0 0 0 不断生成幸运方块，如果在世界生成前加载数据包，还会修改主世界的生成设置。

此数据包依赖于 Lucky Block（CurseForge MCMOD GitHub）。

 基础功能

- 本数据包会将 0 0 0 处的空气替换为幸运方块。
- 本数据包会修改主世界的生成设置，正常的地形将不会生成。
- 本数据包会每 10 秒清除一次 0 0 0 至 0 255 0 的其他方块。
- 本数据包会修改世界出生点为 0 1 0，并修改重生点半径为 0。此时，玩家将始终重生在 0 0 的最高非空气方块上。
- 本数据包会将 0 0 0 附近三格内的掉落物传送至 0 1 0，玩家掉落的物品不会被传送。请注意，玩家掉落物品不仅指玩家仍出的物品，还包括玩家死亡后掉落的物品。
- 本数据包会将所有 y 坐标小于 -64 的实体（除掉落物）传送至 0 20 0。
- 本数据包会将所有处于下界维度的玩家传送至主世界。

 可用命令

以下命令不需要任何权限。

 MITH： /trigger minecraft.is.too.hard 

- 输入一次开启，再次输入关闭。
- 启用后会持续给予启用玩家夜视、发光效果。
- 启用后会使启用玩家无法获得黑暗效果。
- 启用后会有以下全局效果：
 - 开启死亡不掉落；
 - 锁定时间为白天；
 - 锁定天气为晴天；
 - 锁定难度为简单。

 关碰撞： /trigger no.friendly.fire.and.collision 

- 输入一次开启，再次输入关闭。
- 启用后会禁用玩家间的碰撞和友伤。

 垃圾桶： /trigger clear.offhand 

- 输入一次开启，再次输入关闭。
- 启用后会清除玩家副手物品。

 游玩须知

- 请 务必 在创建世界时添加数据包，并保持世界类型为默认，否则数据包将无法运行。
- 较低版本（1.18 以下）主世界最低

Tired of grinding the vanilla enchanting table, building libraries, and hoarding XP just to land the enchantments you actually want? This mod gives you two new workstations that let you rearrange enchantments as freely as you sort your inventory.

It has support for entities as well, which some mods use for rendering fps-heavy features.

In a perfect world every mod is optimized and well tested together, but with modpacks commonly containing over 100 mods, this world does not exist. So I made this to make multiplayer modpacks more playable!

- Hugely better framerates near busy, complex bases containing lots of modded tile entities and entities (such as machines, lights, etc.)

- Client side only mod

Cons:
- more obvious pop-in of said entities and tile entities as you get closer

The project code was created with help of Artificial Intelligence. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

An open source mod with mix of small optimizations for your Minecraft. Less stutters, slightly faster resource loading and world generation, less memory usage .

The main thing Lomka does is reduce the number of redundant garbage (memory) allocations and improves game calcs.

 Optimizations
 Frame time 
- Fewer allocations in the render, tick and collision loops (vertex writes, pose stacks, entity block sweeps)
- Cached font glyph advances (deprecated)
- Cheaper math and color engine
- Faster texture atlas animation (lazily cycle)
- Playing a sound skips the wait for the sound thread
- Removing Thread.yield() from the client tick loop

 Loading and memory 
- Bulk NBT array reads for world, player and structure data on the server side (chunks, heightmaps and saves load in blocks instead of per-element str

There is no good way to stabilize a part of a simulated contraption in a simple and compact manner. Unless you are using this mod, as it adds one way to do that.

 Stabilizer Bearing
Using this bearing, you will be able to stabilize a sub-contraption. Of course if the Stabilizer bearing is not simulated itself, it will just point the attached contraption upwards (or straight forward depending on the placement).

Better Combat Punchy Fix

Client-side compatibility fix for using Better Combat and Punchy together with shaders on NeoForge.

Some shader pipelines can make the first-person item render twice during Better Combat attacks when Punchy is installed. This mod suppresses the vanilla/Punchy first-person render only while Better Combat's real attack animation layer is active, then resets Punchy's transient pose state once the attack ends.

 What it does

- Fixes duplicated first-person weapons during Better Combat attacks.
- Keeps Better Combat attack animations visible.
- Keeps Punchy enabled outside active Better Combat attack animations.
- Does not change damage, cooldowns, hitboxes, attack speed, networking, or server behavior.

 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Better Combat
- Punchy

This mod is client-side only and can be used on vanilla or modded servers.

LagGoggles Legacy

A backport of TerminatorNL's LagGoggles to 1.7.10.

 Dependencies
- FalsePatternLib
- UniMixins

 Original description:

Intuitive lag hunting!

LagGoggles is a profiler where you can see timings in the world, visually. It comes with a custom GUI using a
configurable keybind.

You can use LagGoggles as a player too! This is my attempt to create an understanding of what causes lag on a server to regular players.

I noticed some common misconceptions like having machines spread out over different chunks causes less lag than putting it in one chunk.

With LagGoggles, you can look around and see that alot of small things like pipes or cables cause a tiny bit of lag most of the time, often resulting in more lag than a machine right next to the source would.

 Video explaining the concept
Massive thanks to Grok DuckFarmer for making this video.

Minecraft Talk 35 - LagGoggle

Icarus Wings is a Minecraft mod taking inspiration from the Greek mythology of Icarus, revolving around elements related to wings and sky.

There are two main branches in this mod, one focusing on the Greek mythology, which gives players the ability to craft feather wings to fly in the early stages of survival, but with some limitations to not break the gameplay balance. 🧼 Clean Hitbox

Clean Hitbox is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21 that enhances the vanilla debug hitbox system (F3 + B) with improved visuals, better clarity, and combat friendly highlighting without changing any gameplay mechanics. 
 Oe Just Use A "V" Keybind TO Open GuI

afterburner:
Afterburner makes Minecraft run faster without changing how the game looks or plays. It works on a client, on a server, or both. The mod is customizable, and you can check out video settings for configuration. (or config/afterburner.properties )

 

 What it improves

 Rendering
- Batched chunk drawing: each 128x64x128 block region is drawn with one call instead of one call per chunk section.
- Smaller chunk vertices: 16 bytes per vertex instead of 28, so the graphics card reads less for every block face. Chunks also take less graphics memory.
- Occlusion culling: chunks hidden behind nearer terrain (hills, caves, walls) aren't drawn. Works on OpenGL and Vulkan.
- Entity culling: mobs, chests, signs and other entities hidden behind terrain aren't drawn.
- Face culling: block faces that point away from the camera are skipped.
- Translucent face culling: the same for water, glass and ice.

Afterburner使Minecraft运行得更快，而不改变游戏的外观和玩法。它可以在客户端、服务器或两者上运行。模组是可定制的，你可以查看视频设置进行配置。（或config/afterburner.properties） 渲染 批处理方块绘制：每个128 x64 x128方块区域绘制一次调用，而不是每个方块部分一次调用。 - 较小的方块顶点： - 每个顶点16个字节而不是28个字节，因此显卡对每个方块面的读取更少。方块占用的显存也更少。遮挡剔除：隐藏在较近的地形（山丘、洞穴、墙壁）后面的方块不被绘制。适用于OpenGL和Vulkan。 - 实体剔除：隐藏在地形后面的怪物、箱子、标志和其他实体不会被绘制。 - 面剔除：跳过指向远离摄影机的方块面。 - 半透明面剔除：对于水、玻璃和冰也是如此。 - Translucent face culling: the same for water, glass and ice.

Description
This is a mod that lets you save your position and rotation of your camera so you can load it later, the main purpose of this mod is for the use of thumbnail makers that often save specific positions.

 Usage
Currently everything works via commands, with the prefix of vm (view marks) you can perform the following commands.
- /vmsave : Will save your coords and rotation of your camera, you must specify a label and an optional argument to save the FOV.
- /vmlist : Will show the last 10 saved positions, in the format: 1. Test, FOV 50 .
- /vmload : Will load the specified position with its specified fov, you must enter the corresponding number that appears on your /vmlist 
- /vmwipe : Will delete all the data of your saved positions.

hold-my-guns:
HMI x VPB Compatibility Patch

A lightweight patch mod designed to fix the rendering conflict between Hold My Items and Vic's Point Blank (VPB) .

 Note: This release is specifically for Minecraft 1.21.11 . While I do not currently have plans to support other versions, the source code is uploaded for anyone who wishes to backport it.

---

 Overview
When both mods are active, Hold My Items overrides the first-person rendering pipeline. This prevents Vic's Point Blank guns from displaying their custom animations and breaks the Aim Down Sights (ADS) functionality. 

This patch fixes that behavior by:
 Detecting when a VPB weapon is held.
 Bypassing the HMI animation system for those specific items.
 Restoring VPB's native animations and scoping mechanics.
 Preserving HMI animations for all other items.

---

 Project Details
 Platform: Fabric
 Side: Client-side only
 Requirements: 
 Minecr

MCAI - Minecraft (Character) Artificial Intelligence

Have you ever played Minecraft alone? Well, let me tell you something - it gets very lonely, very quickly when you're all alone in a vast blocky world and the only human-ish thing in the game just makes 'hrm' and 'huh' noises. This mod aims to alleviate that by providing you access to your very own AIs for you to chat with.

 Setup
MCAI requires setup to work properly. This is because c.ai, like most websites, requires an authorization token before it gives you any data.

Thankfully, obtaining your authorization token is simple.

First, head to c.ai. Log in or create a new account.

Then, open Inspect Element, navigate to Application, find Local Storage - https://beta.character.ai
 
 

Once you're there, you will need to find a key called char token . This should be a JSON file with two keys; value and ttl . You can ignore the ttl key

Add ores and structures from newly installed mods to your existing Minecraft world.

Retrogen is a server-side world-generation mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 . It processes already generated chunks as they are loaded and adds compatible ores and structures from mods that were installed later.

Normally, new world-generation content only appears in unexplored areas. Retrogen allows you to continue using your existing world without travelling thousands of blocks just to find newly added resources or structures.

 Features

 Adds modded ores to existing chunks
 Adds modded structures to existing chunks
 Uses the original generation settings from the source mod
 Preserves biome, height, frequency, spread, and block replacement rules
 Supports imported and custom terrain
 Can adjust surface structures to match the existing landscape
 Processes chunks gradually to reduce server lag

visible-block-entities:
What This Mod Does
 Visible Block Entities makes block entities viewable anywhere inside the set render distance. This is especially useful for bases that make heavy use of banners or other block entities in their design. 
 How does it work?
Visible Block Entities overrides the hard-coded 64 block rendering limit for block entities. Instead it uses the set render distance to calculate the rendering limit to make it practically unnoticeable.

- Performance drops may occur if there is too many block entities in the set render distance. This can simply be fixed by lowering the set render distance or installing a performance enhancing mod. 
- Due to how this mod overwrites base Minecraft code, there is always a possibility this can cause incompatibilities with another mod. At this time, there is no known incompatibilities with any other mod.

no-anvil-limit:
A Fabric mod that removes the anvil's level 40 "Too Expensive!" cap, allowing unlimited enchantment combinations and repairs.

 Features

- Removes the level 40 limit from anvils.
- Combine highly-enchanted items and repair gear without ever hitting "Too Expensive!".
- Create enchantment combinations that were previously impossible in survival.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers.

 Usage

Use anvils as normal — the level cap is simply gone, so any valid combine or repair goes through regardless of its XP level cost.

 Environment

The anvil cost is calculated server-side, so the mod only needs to be installed where the world runs (a dedicated server, or the integrated server in singleplayer). Clients connecting to a modded server do not need it.

 Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

 Compatibility

Minecraft 26.2 (also available for 1.21.8).

 Source

Open source (MIT) — gith

simple-fishing-overhaul:
Simple Fishing Overhaul

Ever thought that it's weird that when fishing, you aren't fishing the actual fish that are physically in the water? Even weirder, you can kill said fish to get them as an item, so what's the point of using the fishing rod and waiting when you can just go in the water and do that instead?

- In order to catch fish, they need to be in a certain range of the bobber.
- Hold right-click to charge the fishing rod - the longer you charge, the farther the hook gets thrown.
- When the bobber hits the water, fish have a small chance to become intrigued by it and move towards it. Fish that swim nearby later

CommandsSpy
A mod to log commands to the server console. Both existing and non-existing commands are logged. Commands that are permitted or not are added to the server logs as well.

 Installation
Simply place the mod into the mods directory of your server, and it will start monitoring executed commands.
On startup, the config file will be created automatically.

 Examples
Player "Ultra MC" executing "/gamemode creative" command is logged without arguments in server logs when using config "logArguments": false (default):
 
[18:57:06] [Server thread/INFO]: [CommandsSpy] [Player: Ultra MC] gamemode
 

Player "Ultra MC" executing "/gamemode creative" command is logged with arguments in server logs when using config "logArguments": true :
 
[18:57:06] [Server thread/INFO]: [CommandsSpy] [Player: Ultra MC] gamemode creative
 

Player "Ultra MC" executing "/op" command is logged in server logs

- 🧵 Viewing thread information 
- 🖥️ Reporting system runtime details 
- 📈 Running JFR (Java Flight Recorder) profiling

- ✅ Server only 
- ✅ Client only 
- ✅ Both sides 

Supports Fabric , Forge , and NeoForge loaders.

Includes enhanced and readable output formatting.

---

/ste

Item Render Optimizer

Item Render Optimizer is a lightweight client-side performance mod designed to improve FPS when large numbers of dropped items are visible at once.

Minecraft can become extremely demanding when thousands of dropped item entities are rendered simultaneously. This mod reduces that rendering workload by dynamically limiting how many dropped items are visually rendered when large item piles are present.

 Features

 Significantly improves FPS around large item piles
 Dynamically reduces item rendering as the number of visible items increases
 Keeps the actual items and their functionality unchanged
 Does not change item pickup or item merging behavior
 Designed for situations with hundreds or thousands of dropped items

The mod becomes increasingly aggressive when more dropped items are present, allowing your client to spend less time rendering individual item models.

Easy Auto Restart

Easy Auto Restart is a lightweight Fabric mod designed to add simple automatic restarting capabilities to your Minecraft server. It focuses on doing one thing well: managing restarts and executing your start script when the server stops.

 Commands

All commands require Operator (OP) permissions.

 /restart 
 Stops the server immediately and triggers the restart script.
 /cancelrestart 
 Cancels any currently running restart countdown.
 /easyautorestart restart 
 Initiates a restart sequence with a 1-minute countdown.
 /easyautorestart add 
 Adds a new daily auto-restart time (e.g., /easyautorestart add 04:00 ).
 /easyautorestart remove 
 Removes an existing daily restart time.
 /easyautorestart list 
 Displays all currently scheduled daily restart times.

 Configuration

 The configuration file is generated at config/easy-auto-restart.json . You can edit this file dir

sublanguage:
首选语言 Sublanguage

这是一款功能简单的模组，为客户端提供更多语言配置项，包括物品名双语显示、第二语言。十分适合模组缺少本地翻译或学习其他语言的玩家。当然用户还可以借助该功能对一些物品备注。双语显示效果如模组封面，会更改物品提示框中的标题和切换手中物品的小标题内容。
正常情况下游戏将会优先翻译为首选的语言，其次为第二语言、英语，开启双语显示后若物品没有自定义名称，且首选语言和第二语言的翻译都存在，将在提示框中以 [首选][分隔符][第二] 的格式显示物品名。

- v1.2 新增成就标题、旗帜图案的双语显示，背包里状态效果图标也可支持双语。
 - 
- v1.1 支持附魔属性、药水效果等双语显示。
 - 

 配置教程

本模组的默认第二语言为台湾繁体（zh tw），且双语显示功能 默认关闭 ，两种语言间的连接符默认为 - 。

要更改这些配置，请打开游戏目录下的 config\sublanguage.txt 文件修改，若无该配置项请手动写入或启动一次。
 对于模组版本 <1.2 的，请在 options.txt 文件修改。

- sublanguage ：第二语言代码
- bilingualDisplay ：是否开启物品名双语显示（true/false）
- bilingualSeparator ：物品名双语分隔符
- bilingualItemTooltips ：是否开特殊物品属性双语显示（true/false） v1.1 新增 

若需要启动前请手动加入：
 
sublanguage:en us
bilingualDisplay:true
bilingualSeparator: - 
bilingualItemTooltips:true

multiplied-drops:
Double Blocks Challenge is a chaotic survival challenge mod that increases drops every time you break a block or kill a mob.

How it works:
- Every block you mine increases a global multiplier by +2
- Every mob you kill also increases the multiplier
- All future drops (blocks AND animals) are multiplied by this value

Example:
1st block → x1
2nd block → x3
3rd block → x5
4th block → x7
...

This applies to:
- Logs
- Stone
- Ores
- Animals (meat, leather, etc.)

The multiplier is global and keeps increasing throughout your playthrough.

⚠️ Warning:
This mod gets very overpowered over time and may cause lag if too many items spawn.

Perfect for:
- Survival challenges
- Speedruns
- Content creation
- Chaos runs

Client-side display is minimal — this is meant to be a raw gameplay modifier.

Have fun breaking your world :)

Ol'Foundry

One block. The Foundry smelts like a furnace, but faster with additionnal stuff.

 

 Dripstone lava accelerator
 Slag bricks and dripstone: put a slag bricks block between a lava source and a hanging dripstone tip above a cauldron. Lava drips through at 3× speed.

 How it works

Any furnace fuel works. Speed depends on what you burn:

- Most fuels — 1×
- Coal / charcoal — 1.5×
- Magma cream — 2×
- Blaze rod — 3×

The Foundry also has a 4-bucket lava tank. Fill it and smelting doubles in speed — stacks with the fuel bonus, so a blaze rod with lava hits 6×. The tank drains while it works. Fill it by hand, via the bucket slot, or pipe lava in from the side.

 Slag

Ore smelting drops slag as a byproduct. You can:

- Reprocess it for iron or gold nuggets (lava in the tank gives an extra roll)
- Craft it into slag bricks 
- Burn it as fuel, or compost it

Echoing Sculk Sensors
 

 Description
This adds Echoing Sculk Sensors into the game. They are a new type of Sculk Sensor, which remembers the first sound it hears and will react only to that one sound from that point forwards. 

The stored sound is based on game events rather than frequencies, which means that if you store for example "swimming" sound, it will react only to "swimming" and not to "steps" even though both events have the same frequency. You can see the specific stored game event in F3 screen under "stored sound".
 Note that the original game event gets lost when using resonance through Amethyst Blocks, which causes the game event to change to "resonate X".

 You can clear the stored sound by either right-clicking the block or by powering it with redstone from the "calibration" side. When it doesn't have a sound stored, the crystal will be dimmed to indicate the state.

simple-crop-harvester:
Simple Crop Harvester

 Simple Crop Harvester is a lightweight Fabric mod that makes farming faster and easier.

Instead of breaking and replanting crops one by one, you can simply right-click a fully grown crop to harvest it. The mod will also harvest a few nearby mature crops and automatically replant them if you have the correct seeds or replant items in your inventory.

 Features

 Right-click mature crops to harvest them
 Harvests the clicked crop and up to 3 nearby mature crops 
 Automatically replants crops if you have the correct seed/item
 Works with wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, and nether wart
 Does nothing to crops that are not fully grown
 Lightweight and simple to use
 Works in singleplayer
 Works server-side on multiplayer servers

 How to use

1. Install Fabric Loader 
2. Install Fabric API 
3. Put Simple Crop Harvester in your mods folder
4. Join a world or server

stronghold-finder-one-eye:
One eye stronghold finder 
A client-side fabric mod which allows you to find stronghold with only one Eye of Ender.

 Instructions 
Just throw Eye of Ender and mod will write the coordinates of nearest stronghold in the chat.
Green coordinates mean that the structure is most likely located here. The accuracy that the first coordinates will be a stronghold is 95%.

 

 How it works 
The mod takes the initial and final coordinates of the eye, draws a ray, calculates the nearest intersections with the corners of the chunks and outputs the found data to the chat. Like Ninjabrain Bot, but ingame and less accurate.

Updated from https://modrinth.com/mod/one-eye-stronghold-finder to 26.2

A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1, 1.21.1 and 1.21.11 that gives certain mobs a chance to fixate on and destroy nearby light sources, creating dangerous dark zones and rewarding players who pay attention.

 What it does

Some mobs will occasionally lock onto nearby torches, lanterns, and campfires and attempt to destroy them. A fixated mob glows and emits soul fire particles, giving an observant player a chance to react before their lighting is gone. autoverse:
Description

Autoverse is a mod for compacting vanilla-type automation contraptions, and adding new possibilities for automation.

Autoverse is for the most part focused around doing things based on the sequence of arriving items. In other words, "commands" and data are stored and transferred encoded as the order of item sequences. For this purpose the mod has (among other things) (item) Pipes, FIFO Buffers, Filters, Splitters, Muxers, Sequencers and Sequence Detectors, which can be used to control and direct the item flow into different places, where it can do various things.

Most of the machines in this mod can be programmed by the incoming item sequence, and then during "normal operation", they can be again reset by an arriving matching reset item sequence, after which they can be programmed again using different settings.

 

 Short Background

The project for which this mod was ori

knockable:
Knockable

Knockable is a light-weight Fabric Minecraft mod which enables
you to knock on blocks to make your presence known.

Just use the newly added "Knock" Keybind on any valid block.

 ✨ Features

- Knock on blocks to play a knocking sound
- Depending on the targeted block different functionality can be used
 - BlockEntity with an Inventory: Pitch of the sound is based on how many Item Slots are not empty
 - Blocks without Inventories: Pitch of the sound is based on distance to the targeted block

 🔧 Configuration

- Knockable blocks can be specified with the newly added knockable:knockable block tag, but by default, all blocks in door, trapdoor, chests and barrel block tags are included
- Using the "knockingRange" Gamerule, the max distance of valid knocking can be specified

---

mellowmod:
Mellow is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that smoothly lowers render distance during loading and gradually increases it after joining a world. By starting at 2 chunks and ramping up to 6 chunks over time, Mellow reduces initial lag and stuttering while keeping exploration smooth and responsive.

It's designed to reduce the initial memory and performance demand on QuestCraft as the client loads into a server.

Zonne's Duplication Mod

This mod adds a simple highly configurable duplication command working with cheats disabled.

---

Features:

- /dupe (amount dupeamount)
- /megadupe (amount^dupeamount)
- /d and /md (Shortened variants of the commands above)

The configuration file allows setting a duplication limit to both commands individually, setting command error messages, and allows disabling any of the 4 added commands.

There is also an option to have duplicating cost XP levels or points, and one to disable bottle of enchanting duplication.

The mod also includes a helpful unstackable item fix making megadupe function like normal dupe with unstackable items (can be disabled in config)

---

Zonnes Duplication was tested on 1.21.4 and 1.21.8, but works on any version inbetween.
Also works on 26.1.X

Join the discord for support or for reporting bugs.

LevelFix

 LevelFix 是一个轻量级的 Minecraft 模组，旨在修复 Minecraft 中附魔等级与药水效果等级的罗马数字显示问题。原版游戏在等级超过 10 后会显示为 enchantment.level.255 这类占位符，而药水效果在屏幕上的等级显示甚至会完全消失。本模组将这些占位符替换为准确的罗马数字（如 CCLV ），并让效果 UI 中的等级重新出现，使游戏界面回归自然、清晰。

 LevelFix is a lightweight Minecraft mod designed to fix the display of Roman numerals for enchantment and potion effect levels in Minecraft. In vanilla, when levels exceed 10, placeholders such as enchantment.level.255 appear, and potion effect levels may even disappear entirely from the UI. This mod replaces those placeholders with accurate Roman numerals (e.g., CCLV ) and restores the missing level display in the effects UI, bringing the interface back to a natural and clear state.

- 修复附魔等级显示 ：将附魔等级占位符（如 enchantment.level.255 ）转换为正确的罗马数字，最高支持 256 级。

- 修复效果 UI 等级显示 ：修复效果 UI 界面中，超过 10 级的药水效果等级无法显示的问题，使其正确

This server+clientside mod exists so I can allow players at an after-school club to pick a skin, and make it work with a server in offline mode and no internet access on either the server or clients.

You need a webserver (on the LAN) which serves up skins at a custom URL, configured in this config file which the server relies on:

 
 config/rjs offline server skins.txt
skin url template=http://your.ip.or.server/skins/%name%-%rev%.png
 

Template tokens:

- %name% (required): in-game player name

name-formatting-station-datapack:
Name Formatting Station
 
 

A datapack that adds the ability for players to format item names in survival, along with giving the ability to add lore to items.

 

You can start by accessing the menu using: "/trigger FormatName"

Hold a named item in your mainhand to format it.
Formatting an item name costs 1 xp level by default.
You can change the Style, Color, and Font of an item name.
You can merge together item names to mixed format names.
You can add and delete lore from items.
 

You can access the admin configurations by using: /function name formatting:admin
attrition:
Attrition is a simple, vanillalike data pack that’s designed for players who want something harder than regular survival, but not quite as harsh as hardcore mode. Here’s how it works:

- You lose one heart of max health each time you die
- You can gain one heart of max health each time you eat an enchanted golden apple, up to a maximum of 20 hearts
- If you die with only one heart of max health left, you lose the game and are put into spectator mode

---

 What else does it do?

Attrition plays sounds and displays custom chat messages whenever any of these three events happen, but it has no effect on any other aspect of gameplay. This pack is meant to blend in well with vanilla Minecraft – almost as if it were simply an alternative gamemode. sentinel-nests:
Sentinel Nests

This datapack introduces emergent golem architecture to Minecraft villages. When iron golems patrol, they have a chance to place cobblestone blocks in strategic locations around village boundaries, gradually forming low walls, corner towers, and elevated watch platforms.

 Building Behavior

The construction behavior triggers more frequently in villages that have experienced recent hostile mob attacks, tracked through a simple scoring system. Golems prioritize placing blocks near village bells, at pathway intersections, and along edges facing dark areas like forests or caves.

Structures remain modest and utilitarian, never exceeding five blocks in height, keeping the aesthetic grounded and functional rather than fantastical.

 Environmental Variation

Villages in dangerous biomes like swamps or dark oak forests will develop more extensive fortifications over time compare

Random Chunk is a Minecraft Java datapack where walking into a new chunk replaces every solid block in it with one randomly chosen block type. Air, water, and lava are left alone.

 How it works 

- Step onto a chunk you have not visited yet — all solids become the same random block
- The actionbar shows which chunk was converted and what it became
- Return later and the chunk stays as it was
- Overworld, Nether, and End are tracked separately
- The spawn chunk is converted on first load too

The pool includes stone, deepslate, planks, logs, concrete, wool, terracotta, ores, nether blocks, end stone, glass, ice, slime, honey, and a lot more — one type per chunk.

 Install 
Drop the zip into the world’s datapacks folder, then run /reload.

 Op commands 

/function randomchunk:pause
/function randomchunk:resume
/function randomchunk:toggle

 Made for Minecraft Java 26.1–26.3 and newer.

This texture pack gives Minecraft a clean, PvP-focused look with better visibility and a smoother feel in fights—perfect for SMP PvP, duels, and grinding. It was inspired by the YouTuber ManePear , and I created my own version using elements from other packs , with full credits given to their creators .
- This is all from Manepear’s content; I tried my best to recreate it fully .

 Compatibility
- Tested on: 1.21.5 – 1.20.6 (Main version: 1.21+)
- Other versions: Not tested

 Requirements
- No mods required , this pack works on vanilla Minecraft.

 Credits
- Pack created by Melted .
- Some parts were taken from Vanilla Tweaks .
- Some parts of the Low Shield were taken from Shield Corrections .
- Inspired by Manepear .

Manepear覆盖 这个材质包为Minecraft提供了一个干净的，以PVP为中心的外观，具有更好的可见性和更流畅的战斗感觉-非常适合SMP PvP，决斗和研磨。它的灵感来自YouTuber ManePear，我使用其他包的元素创建了我自己的版本，完全归功于他们的创作者。 - 这都是来自Manepear的内容;我尽我所能完全重现它。 兼容性 - 测试版本：1.21.5 - 1.20.6（主版本：1.21+） - 其他版本：未测试 要求 - 不需要模组，这个包适用于原版Minecraft。 学分 - 由Melted创建的包。 - 有些部分是从原版调整。 - 低盾的一些部分是从盾牌更正。 - 灵感来自Manepear。

Sparkles ADDON: Alpha Islands

This resourcepack changes the texture of every blocks and mobs in Terralith's really rare Alpha Islands and Alpha Islands Winter) biomes to an Alpha/Developer counterpart or look. The base Sparkles pack is not required but still recommended.

 Why can't I see the textures?

In order to see the custom block and mob textures, if on Forge, Optifine does work, but we no longer recommend Optifine in any scenario. Otherwise, for Fabric, download the following mods:

- [[ETF] Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
- Continuity

Then, make sure the resourcepack is installed and applied and that you are in an Alpha Islands biome.

 Some blocks never had an "old" counterpart and some looks have yet to be reproduced.

twtgd:
Those Were The Good Days (Or TWTGD) is a resource pack that brings back Minecraft's old textures to more modern versions of the game!\
If you missed the old textures, and like the new versions, this texture pack is for you!\
Zombified piglins (Formerly zombie pigmen) have their old textures back, too (kind of)!\
TWTGD is also performance friendly, so you can play it with barely any lag.

 

This even changes panarormas and titles to the old 1.10 ones, too!

This pack took a while to make, so please enjoy!\
Please report any issues to me!\
Best of all, TWTGD doesn't require anything special, such as Optifine!

Note: TWTGD is still in beta, I cannot guarantee everything will work as intended, but it should.

"You're never gonna unsee the issue in vanilla" - tuopi27 

 About the pack
 Spatial Cross Models is a resourcepack that fixes a visual bug in Minecraft, in which models containing flat planes have parts of their textures pop in and out of existence as you move around them.

By flipping and splitting specific faces and adding more model variations, it makes these models behave more naturally in 3D space and overall more realistically.

 How the Pack works
- The base model for all cross blocks, "cross.json", has both planes split into two parts vertically, and both parts of a plane use only one side of the blocks texture, creating a mirror effect when looking at the block from a diagonal angle, and showing the original texture when looking from the side.
- There is a new type of model for cross blocks called "directional cross.json" for blocks that wouldn't work with the original method b

Overview
 
The Intercity Nieuwe Generatie (ICNG) is a family of high-speed electric multiple units operated by Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS) in the Netherlands. Based on the Alstom Coradia Stream platform, the ICNG was developed to modernise NS's Intercity fleet and provide faster, more comfortable services across the Dutch railway network.

The ICNG is available in both domestic and international configurations, with the trains being designed for operation on the Dutch 1.5 kV DC network as well as higher-voltage systems used on international routes. The fleet includes both four-car and eight-car units, with the trains reaching speeds of up to 200 km/h on suitable high-speed lines.

This resourcepack brings the NS ICNG / Alstom Coradia Stream to the Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR) mod.

The original 3D model was created for Transport Fever 2 by TimothyS and was later ported to MTR by Vitor

Brings the 1.21.6 Locator Bar feature to Paper 1.16.5–1.21.5. Shows nearby players on your Action Bar with real-time directional tracking. No client-side mods required.

 How it works

A bar appears above your hotbar showing the position of nearby players. Icons change based on distance:
- ⬤ — Close (0–179 blocks)
- ■ — Medium (179–230 blocks)
- ● — Far (230–281 blocks)
- • — Very far (281+ blocks)

Vertical arrows ( ꜛ ꜜ ) indicate when a player is above or below you. Each player is assigned a unique color for easy identification, which also appears in the tab list.

 Hiding from the bar

Players are hidden from the Locator Bar when:
- Sneaking
- Under Invisibility effect
- Wearing a mob head or carved pumpkin

 

 
 Commands 

 

- /locatorbar — Toggle the bar on/off 
- /locatorbar on — Enable 
- /locatorbar off — Disable

A Paper, Spigot, and Bukkit plugin for Minecraft 1.21 - 26.3 that helps server administrators find and fix lag caused by loaded chunks.

 
 
 
 

 What is it

ChunkAnalyzer scans loaded chunks and calculates a load score based on entities, tile entities, players, armor stands, redstone components, hoppers, updatable blocks, and light sources. The plugin works in the background, caches results, and exposes the data through an in-game GUI.

grace:
Do you want a grace period without installing an entire SMP management plugin? 

Same.

 Grace does one thing: gives your server a proper grace period before PvP starts.

Start it whenever you want, choose the duration yourself, and everyone gets a countdown at the top of their screen. Until that timer hits zero, players can't hurt each other.

No config editing. 
No server restart. 
No extra systems you never asked for.

Just grace.

 What it does

- Shows a bossbar countdown to everyone online
- Changes from green → yellow → red as time runs out
- Prevents player damage during the grace period
- Blocks projectile damage too, including arrows and tridents 
- Supports custom times like 30s , 10m , 1h30m , etc.
- Lets you pause and resume the timer
- Plays sounds when grace starts and ends

 Commands

 /grace start 
Starts a grace period.

Example: 
 /grace start 10m 

 /grace pause
